origin.description: Return the language, country, variant, and canonical name of a locale.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or '' for the default locale, or one locale identifier.

origin.details: C and c, including C.UTF-8, are read as en_US_POSIX. An empty name selects the current default. A keywords-only identifier keeps the default language and adds the keywords.
origin.value: A list with Language, Country, Variant, and Name.

translation.description: Return the language, country, variant, and canonical name of a locale.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: None or '' for the default locale, or one locale identifier.

translation.details: The canonical name comes from ICU. C and c, including C.UTF-8, become en_US_POSIX. None or '' selects the current default locale.
translation.value: A dict with Language, Country, Variant, and Name. A blank component is an empty string.
